cloneVsOriginalElementAudit.source: element-geometry audit run earlier in this session (orig = vadimcarazan.com/?internal=1, clone = local dev server), same selectors on both, rect = [x, y, w, h] at 1440x900, 1280x800 and 390x844 in states home/fly/project/selected/about/contact/menu
cloneVsOriginalElementAudit.caveat: The clone side was captured with a throwaway sample import ('Sample Case 1' titles), not today's placeholder data, and before the motion fixes. Mismatches are content-driven (different titles, description and gallery lengths, lane caption widths) - chrome geometry (top bar, hero, name, box frame, back pill, flybar frame) is within 1px. It is NOT a pixel parity number.

parity.reason: No live-vs-clone pixel parity harness was run for this design-repo. A pixel compare of '/' is not meaningful as a fidelity number: the clone deliberately renders different work images (procedural), a different portrait, different lettering, signature and copy inside a WebGL field whose tile placement is random per load. The /work/<slug> pages have no counterpart on the original (its case studies live on an external studio site). The available evidence is the element-geometry audit above. No parity percentage is claimed anywhere in this repo.

findings.detail: Fixed in the clone after the first build: the view effect now clears ?work= only when a project view is being closed, so on first render the param survives until handleParams reads it. Verified: '/?work=3' opens the project view (title 'Northwind') after the intro, and Escape clears the param.

Loader stroke drawing, portrait arrival and the signature draw have no reduced-motion branch in the clone (motion-patterns.json fallback 'unchanged'). CLONE_SPEC says the original skips the loader drawing.

Much of the clone's placeholder UI copy is verbatim from the original (e.g. 'Let's make the next one yours.', 'A few to start with.', 'Tell me what you're building.', the needs/budget chips, 'Explore the work'). It is therefore treated as source copy: generated mode rejects it through the phrase list and the 6-word shingle hashes.

The clone builds 12,028 portrait cells from the user-supplied portrait (public/data/portrait.json) vs 7,832 on the original; 200 placeholder images across 100 projects (15 case studies) vs 1,067 / 730.

iaCrossCheck.note: ia/ia.json (16 routes, 2 templates, 25 sections) maps 1:1 onto the contracts through iaSectionId; overlay.glass-box is the one extra contract (the box container, retrieval-ineligible), and the ia's conversion.cta-card is categorised CTA here (it links to the brief form rather than collecting anything). Checked by verify_all.py IA_SYNC when ia/ia.json is present.
